extension.description: Search and Download subtitles from ktuvit.me.
extension.news:
v4.0.9 - by lioree [30.10.2026] - Fix subtitle download errors on Kodi 21 / Android - URL-encode release names and sanitize temp file names - Detect real subtitle format (ASS/SUB/VTT) and unpack zipped subtitles - Retry when the server answers 'request not found' instead of a file - Show 'No subtitles found' / 'Error downloading subtitle' notifications - Do not write the login request (password) to the debug log
v4.0.0 - by CaTz [18.04.2023] - Add support for Kodi Nexus (v20) version
